notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
ssh -v (verbose) reveals the authentication methods the server will accept: publickey, password, keyboard-interactive, gssapi. This determines whether password brute-force is viable (password auth must be enabled).

=== CHAINING ===
ssh -v → if 'password' in auth methods: password brute force viable → hydra/medusa/crackmapexec → if only publickey: need private key from rsync/NFS/SMB exposure or other means.

=== BANNER ===
SSH banner (pre-auth message) sometimes contains system owner information, legal warnings, or version strings useful for CVE lookup. Banner also confirms the service is actually SSH (vs another service on port 22).
